founder-m.instruct: A confident young American man in his late twenties, warm and clear, mid-low pitch. He narrates a startup product launch at a brisk, energetic pace with crisp consonants and a slight smile in his voice. Natural and conversational, never announcer-like or salesy.

founder-f.instruct: A confident young American woman in her late twenties, bright and warm, clear diction. She narrates a startup product launch at a brisk, energetic pace, upbeat and conversational, with natural emphasis on key words. Never salesy or robotic.

keynote-m.instruct: A calm, polished male narrator with a low, smooth voice, like a premium tech keynote film. Measured, intimate and assured, with short deliberate pauses between ideas.
